aboutText: With over 30 years of experience, Flipro has completed more than 150 pre-sale renovations in Beaconsfield and across Melbourne. We specialise in kitchen, bathroom, and full home renovations, allowing homeowners to access funding before selling with no upfront costs. Our deferred payment model ensures a winning strategy for your property sale.
servicesText: From kitchen makeovers to full home transformations, Flipro offers a range of renovation services tailored to Beaconsfield homeowners. We handle everything from design to completion, with deferred payment options to ease the financial burden before your property sale.
